summary.en: Because the mosses and leaves below absorbed most of the impact from the 10 meters fall, Kokusho is actually fine with only some minor bruises. Conan raises doubts that the culprit must have used the Yahamine legend to distract the investigation, and if this case and the previous murder have something to do then the culprit will not stop there. However, he also notices Yamamoto is watching them, Yamamoto states that Tsukada must have been the murder as he heard from Tsukada that he will receive lots of money. Following what has happened recently, Kogoro believes that statement as well, but Conan and Ran suggest that they should talk directly to him before concluding that he is the culprit. However, no one is in Tsukada's house when they arrive along with Taisei, so Kogoro calls the police to help look out the harbor and the airports. Later, The two begin to go to the harbor as soon as Taisei recalls that Tsukada could own a boat while Ran and Conan want to investigate the house a bit for some reason. There, Conan and Ran notice the fresh sawdusts, and a secret passage leading to a railroad, so before they follow the railroad, Conan asks Ran to call Kogoro as there will be no phone service when they go along the way.
